pieces.name: DB04_Lantern_Cage
pieces.note: Lantern body without the lid: source base plate (front-right corner bent up), window frame (M_Forest_PropsCutout frame region on a closed hex prism), dark top collar, handle loop + rope grip (source UVs) bent back/sideways; whole cage leans and twists. Panes 4/5 (front, front-left) knocked out (dark interior + small jagged remnant), the other 4 panes non-glowing amber (M_Forest_Props). Collider = one hull of base+frame+collar, handle left out.

pieces.name: DB04_Lantern_Cage_COL
pieces.note: convex hull of base plate + frame + collar (handle left out)

pieces.name: DB04_Lantern_Lid
pieces.note: Pyramid lid cap copied from the source (darkpatch UVs), bottom closed, two pushed-in dents on the slopes, front-left rim squashed down, top pushed off-centre and twisted.

pieces.name: DB04_Lantern_Glass
pieces.note: Jagged pane shard ~7 x 5 cm, 4 mm thick, one straight frame edge, slight curve; amber region on M_Forest_Props (opaque, no glow).
